name: pixel-32
style_block: Top-down 2D game sprite for a sci-fi spaceship colony sim, RimWorld-like readability. Pixel art, 32x32 tile grid, crisp pixels, no anti-aliasing, no blur. Limited palette: dark desaturated hull greys, steel blue-grey mid-tones, mint green accent #5FE8CB for lights/screens, amber #f0a02a for warnings. Light source top-left, subtle 1px darker outline, flat shading, slight 3/4 top-down view on raised objects. Clean silhouette readable at actual size. No text, no watermark, no drop shadow, centered, plain solid background.

assets.name: anchor_floor
assets.prompt: Spaceship interior deck floor tile, brushed metal plating with subtle panel seams and small rivets, fully seamless/tileable on all four edges, very low contrast. Fills the entire square image.

assets.name: anchor_wall
assets.prompt: Spaceship interior hull wall segment, reinforced armored panel with a top edge highlight and vertical seam, tiles seamlessly when repeated horizontally, darker than the floor. Fills the entire square image.

assets.name: anchor_door
assets.prompt: Closed sliding airlock door set into a wall opening, two metal slabs meeting at a center seam, small mint status light, industrial. Fills the square image.

assets.name: anchor_pawn
assets.prompt: Crew member seen from above, simple rounded jumpsuit silhouette with visible shoulders and head, small mint collar light, neutral grey-blue suit. Centered on a plain solid magenta background (#FF00FF).

assets.name: anchor_growbed
assets.prompt: Hydroponic grow bed, low rectangular metal tray with rows of small green seedlings under a thin light bar, mint glow accent. Centered on a plain solid magenta background (#FF00FF).

assets.name: anchor_terminal
assets.prompt: Ship computer terminal, small console pedestal with an angled screen glowing mint green, viewed from above. Centered on a plain solid magenta background (#FF00FF).
